- Shredded/disintegrated pith
- Stringy vascular strands remaining intact
- Small dark specks/dots scattered throughout
- Overall tan/brown coloration

Key candidates: **Charcoal_stalk_rot** (tiny black sclerotia on vascular strands, grey/charred interior) or **Diplodia_stalk_rot** (macerated tan-brown pith, small black pycnidia). Let me check the reference.

The bottom-right panel of the Charcoal_stalk_rot reference collage is a near-identical match to the test image — same dark blue background, same shredded pith with tan/brown vascular strands, same small dark specks (sclerotia) on the strands. The test image matches Charcoal stalk rot perfectly.
